     § 155-31. Dwelling decontrolled and exempted.
     Provided that a dwelling is registered in accordance with § 155-30 upon the vacation of a
     residential apartment unit by a tenant, the apartment unit shall become decontrolled and exempt
     from the provisions of this chapter for the new tenant's initial rental;

     § 155-32. Circumstances entitling decontrol.
     The landlord shall be entitled to decontrol the apartment unit under this article only under the
     following circumstances:
     A.     If the tenant vacates the apartment voluntarily without harassment, duress or unreasonable
            pressure from the landlord or his agents or if the tenant is legally evicted.
     B.     If the tenant vacates the apartment as a result of a court order from a court of competent
            jurisdiction. This ground shall not be available to a landlord who receives a court order to
            dispossess a tenant based upon the tenant holding over and continuing in possession of the
            premises after the expiration of his term. Whenever there is an issue as to the circumstances
            under which a tenant has vacated an apartment unit, that issue shall be determined by the
